limits: each condition holds by the argument stated with it in engines/numbering.py (unique factorization, a total decision procedure, shifting positions to larger primes); the generated objects, corrupted codes and random integers are its witnesses (tier bounded); natural provability is checked as the card's statement
name: W5_admissible_numberings

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-5

statement: Every Gödel set states its numbering and passes all 6 conditions (injective, effective, decidable_image, codes_start_at_1, parts_smaller, natural_provability): B0 (48 atoms with the sets it extends, 1406 checks); computation (61 atoms with the sets it extends, 1459 checks); machines (57 atoms with the sets it extends, 1309 checks). Provability is ∃ of the decidable proof relation (Lean's kernel) with no further clause, so a set's consistency statement means what Rule-12 says, and Feferman's deviant predicates are excluded.
